content: {"reasoning":"The denial is for missing required prior authorization, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. A medical-necessity appeal does not cure the authorization defect and paid 0 of 6 similar claims; resubmission would likewise be improper and ineffective. With no secondary coverage and no contractual basis to transfer a provider authorization failure to the patient, the balance is uncollectible.","action":"write_off"}
